rules.statement: A written consent from a husband is not required to appear on the face of the document for it to be valid under section 8 of the Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "There is no such requirement in law. In Fradd v. Fernando (2) Dalton J., observed that it is not necessary that the consent should appear on the face of the document making the disposition or that it should be given by a writing notarially executed."
